summary: Duplicate Advisory: ip-address: Address6 matches a zone identifier in quadratic time ahead of its length limit, allowing a single long string to stall the process
details:
## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
ip-address before 10.7.4 allows a denial of service (CPU consumption from quadratic complexity, and application stall) via many % characters in input reaching a function call that uses the Address6 constructor.
